text_en: First it rained down horrible insects and now we're the victims of these earthquakes.
I'm starting to think that this city isn't as tranquil as they had us believe.
Although, to tell you the truth, I'm glad.
It's boring waiting around with nothing going on. At least this way there's some excitement.
I'd help you, but you know... I didn't end up in a particularly good way after our nearly-twenty-metre fall...
